studio_quote: A building is a gift to the world. It must be worthy of the ground it occupies, the people who use it, and the time that will outlast it.
phil_3_text: Architecture, interior, turnkey execution, and furniture. Every dimension of your space, designed and delivered in concert.
phil_2_text: A limited number of commissions each year. Each project receives our undivided attention — from brief to the day we hand you the key.
phil_1_text: The principal who designs is the same person accountable for delivery. No handoffs, no dilution of intent.
author_bio: Riddhi founded Blue Door Architects with the belief that good design is not a luxury — it is a responsibility. With over a decade of practice across residential, commercial and hospitality projects in Gujarat, she leads every project from brief to handover.
